Packing and Marking Goods shall be packed suitably to prevent moisture, dust, deformation and damage during transit and stor age. Packages shall be marked with item description, quantity, size (where relevant), supplier details and purchase order refer ence. Packaging material and handling shall be included in the quoted price unless otherwise specified. 10. Inspection and Acceptance The consignee or an authorised inspection representative shall inspect the goods after delivery for quantit y, identity, size, workmanship, material quality and conformity with the accepted technical offer. Receipt of goods shall not by itself constitute final acceptance. Acceptance shall be recorded after satisfactory inspection. The purchaser may reject goo ds that are damaged, defective, counterfeit, used or non-conforming. 11. Replacement of Defective or Rejected Goods The supplier shall collect and replace rejected, damaged, defective or incorrectly sized goods within ____ d ays of written intimation, at no additional cost, including transport and handling. The replacement shall meet the same s pecifications and shall be subject to re-inspection. 12. Warranty The supplier shall provide a minimum warranty of ____ months from the date of acceptance against defect s in material and workmanship, or the manufacturer's standard warranty, whichever is more favourable to the purchaser. W arranty coverage and exclusions shall be stated in the bid. For consumable or non-warranted accessories, the supplier shall at le ast ensure that goods are new and free from defects at delivery. 13. Documents to be Supplied The supplier shall provide the invoice, delivery challan, item-wise packing list, warranty details where appli cable, manufacturer/product literature and any test or conformity documents specifically required under the bid. All documents shall identify the supplied make/model and sizes. 14. Payment Payment shall be made through the applicable GeM/payment procedure after successful delivery, inspecti on and acceptance, and submission of a correct invoice and required documents, subject to applicable government financial ru les and platform conditions. No advance payment shall be made unless specifically authorised in the bid and permitted by a pplicable rules. 15. Liquidated Damages and Delay Any liquidated damages for delay shall be governed by the applicable GeM terms, procurement rules and the specific bid/contract conditions. If a separate rate or cap is intended, it must be expressly inserted in the final bid a nd must not conflict with platform conditions. 16. Force Majeure Force majeure shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and contract conditions. Th e affected party shall notify the other party in writing within the period prescribed by the contract and provide reasonable suppo rting particulars. 17. Integrity and Ethical Conduct The bidder shall not offer, promise or give any undue gratification or benefit to any person in connection w ith the procurement. The bidder shall disclose any conflict of interest and comply with applicable government procurement rule s and the GeM terms.

18. Dispute Resolution and Governing Conditions Disputes shall be handled in accordance with the applicable GeM terms, the contract and the laws of India. The final bid shall specify the competent authority and jurisdiction, where required and legally permissible. 19. Purchaser's Rights The purchaser reserves the rights available under the applicable procurement rules and platform condition s, including verification of documents, seeking clarifications, rejecting non-responsive bids, cancelling the procurement for recorded reasons and taking action for breach of contract.
